encoding_notes: Registry keys are stable IDs. References use IDs, never display names.
JSON is the canonical agent package; its Markdown companion is a generated view.
Resolved rosters are materialized from faction data and explicit deltas, not separately authored.
Null means unspecified in the design. It never means zero, free, instant, absent or prohibited.
Passive percentage modifiers are typed. Conditional abilities, research effects and power effects retain their full normative prose and are not claimed to be executable.
Preserved source text and typed fields describe the same rule; never apply both as separate bonuses.
No new balance values, lore changes or unit abilities are introduced by this serialization.

setting.premise:
The year is 2086. The Meridian Network once linked regional power grids, freight routing, desalination controls and disaster forecasting. It did not create energy: it made a fragile, unequal world depend on coordinated delivery. During the Long Blackout of 2057, cascading technical failures and competing emergency shutdowns broke that coordination. No faction can prove whether the first failure was sabotage, negligence or an attempt to prevent something worse.

Over three decades, reconstruction commands hardened into eight rival blocs. Meridian's surviving regional control vaults can now reconnect major industrial corridors. Whoever governs those connections can restore livelihoods, ration access or shut rivals out. The war is fought for substations, ports, salvage fields, manufacturing cities and the right to decide who gets power first.

Each faction offers a credible public good and an institutional danger. None is a stand-in for the moral character of a present-day country, religion or population. National names identify fictional successor commands; their military doctrines come from reconstruction history. All names and technology below are proposals, not canon that the game must retain.

timeline.description: A patchwork of national projects becomes an interdependent energy and logistics system.
Nine months of cascading regional failures trigger evacuations, rationing and emergency rule.
Convoy services, local governments and surviving militaries form new political alliances.
Eight blocs negotiate temporary transit rights while rebuilding military industry.
A disputed restart at Meridian Vault Nine cuts power to several neutral cities. Every bloc mobilizes; the responsible decision remains contested.

campaign_fault_lines.description: Both support international reconstruction, but disagree over military occupation versus binding civilian oversight. A shared relief operation can become a confrontation over who commands it.
They need each other's ports and power exchanges. The conflict is whether water access can be guaranteed by treaty when solar plants remain under exclusive control.
Shared coastal trade encourages cooperation; rival corridor tariffs and control of desalination machinery create a practical, non-religious source of conflict.
Both seek coordinated industrial recovery, but each wants authority over the continental scheduling system. Border depots and railway junctions become bargaining chips.
Shipping access and the political independence of treaty ports are the central dispute. Capturing a port is easy compared with persuading its residents to accept the winner.
They can cooperate over evacuation routes yet clash over who inspects maritime cargo and where foreign bases may operate.
They share an interest in independent reconstruction technology but compete over industrial contracts and access to eastern shipping corridors.

Each campaign should include one mission where following central orders damages the faction's stated purpose. Subfactions disagree over methods, resources and authority rather than existing only as cosmetic national teams.

rule.design.roster_selection.title: Roster selection
rule.design.roster_selection.text: Choose one of 32 playable rosters before the match: 8 vanilla factions or one of their 24 subfactions. A subfaction inherits its parent faction's traits, structures, service units, two shared upgrades, two shared powers and superweapon. It replaces exactly two combat units, loses one additional combat unit, gains one exclusive upgrade, and replaces the vanilla-only third power with its own. You cannot mix subfaction packages.

rule.design.economy.title: Economy
rule.design.economy.text: One spendable resource: credits, earned by Collectors delivering salvage from designated deposits to Refineries. Power is a separate capacity budget, not currency. No faction needs a second harvest resource. Suggested starting preset: one deployed HQ and 7,500 credits; medium game speed; no veterancy in the first balance prototype.

rule.design.technology.title: Technology
rule.design.technology.text: T1 is the opening roster. Radar unlocks T2. Radar plus Laboratory unlock T3. A unit always needs its listed producer as well. No faction needs a Dock to unlock land or air technology; every roster is playable on a land-only map.

rule.design.production.title: Production
rule.design.production.text: Each Barracks, Factory, Airfield and Dock has one independent queue. Research uses one player-wide queue. Building construction uses one player-wide queue. Additional production structures add queues, not hidden speed bonuses. A replaced unit cannot also be built.

rule.design.research.title: Research
rule.design.research.text: Upgrades cost the listed credits and take 45 seconds at T2 or 75 seconds at T3. T2 research requires an intact Radar; T3 research requires Radar and Laboratory. Completed upgrades persist if those buildings are lost. Losing a tech prerequisite pauses dependent unfinished unit and research orders until rebuilt.

rule.design.power_loss.title: Power loss
rule.design.power_loss.text: During a shortage, normal production and research progress at 50% speed; powered defenses and Relay bonuses stop. Powered Radar/Laboratory support powers cannot activate. Superweapon recharge pauses. Existing units and completed upgrades continue to work. SAP defense reserves are the stated exception, not a second resource.

rule.design.scope_of_modifiers.title: Scope of modifiers
rule.design.scope_of_modifiers.text: Combat-unit modifiers apply to the listed combat roster, including its support specialists, but not the four shared service units unless explicitly stated. Structure modifiers apply only to the named structure class. Transport bonuses include any unit explicitly tagged Transport. Units retain role tags when replaced unless the replacement explicitly changes role.

rule.design.how_percentages_combine.title: How percentages combine
rule.design.how_percentages_combine.text: Apply three layers: base specification, then parent-faction modifiers, then subfaction modifiers, then research/temporary effects. Within a layer, changes to the same stat add; layers multiply. Example: parent vehicle health +10% and subfaction vehicle health -10% yield 1.10 x 0.90 = 0.99 of the base health. Bonuses with identical sources never stack.

rule.design.caps_and_interpretation.title: Caps and interpretation
rule.design.caps_and_interpretation.text: Final purchase cost and build time cannot fall below 60% of the base specification. Final reload interval cannot fall below 50%. Combined damage resistance cannot reduce incoming weapon damage by more than 50%, except a successful projectile interception which removes that projectile. Build time -20% means 0.80 times the duration; it is not the same as production progressing 20% faster.

rule.design.prototype_boundary.title: Prototype boundary
rule.design.prototype_boundary.text: The percentages, power prices and timings are initial tuning targets. The bible defines roles and prerequisites, not final weapon damage, armor tables, model counts, pathfinding or unit prices. Each unique unit needs its own base stat specification; replacing a unit does not imply identical stats.

rule.combat.support_power_access.title: Support-power access
rule.combat.support_power_access.text: Each roster has exactly three support powers: two inherited powers and one vanilla-only or subfaction-specific power. T2 powers require a powered Radar; T3 powers require powered Radar and Laboratory. Powers cost credits per use, have separate cooldowns in seconds, and are ready when first unlocked. Rebuilding a prerequisite never resets a cooldown.

rule.combat.targeting_and_warnings.title: Targeting and warnings
rule.combat.targeting_and_warnings.text: Reconnaissance powers may target any map location. Other support powers need current vision unless their text explicitly supplies reconnaissance. Superweapons may target previously explored terrain without current vision. Strategic warning zones are visible to affected players and cannot be hidden by fog or decoys.

rule.combat.superweapon_control.title: Superweapon control
rule.combat.superweapon_control.text: A strategic structure starts empty and charges only with enough power and intact Radar/Laboratory. One charge may be stored; no stockpiling. The full recharge starts at activation. Destruction or EMP shutdown of the launcher during its warning cancels the attack without refunding the charge; an ordinary power shortage after activation does not cancel it. Ordinary AA cannot intercept strategic attacks except the explicitly shootable Tempest drones.

rule.combat.damage_and_area_notation.title: Damage and area notation
rule.combat.damage_and_area_notation.text: One cell means one ordinary terrain tile. A radius is measured from the marked center; all times are real-time seconds at normal speed. Damage-bearing area attacks can hurt friendlies. Aurora affects enemies only; summoned attackers select enemies only. Support buffs affect friendlies unless the text explicitly says otherwise.

rule.combat.interception_and_strategic_p.title: Interception and strategic packets
rule.combat.interception_and_strategic_p.text: For Trident, each Atlas rod, Perun core/ring blast, Horizon impact, Tempest drone hit and Dragonfall engine shot is one impact packet. Eight charges reduce one packet by 50%. Fewer than eight cannot reduce it. Helios and Aurora bypass Trident as beam and EMP effects. All reductions still obey the overall 50% resistance cap.

rule.combat.concealment_and_electronic_w.title: Concealment and electronic warfare
rule.combat.concealment_and_electronic_w.text: Camouflaged units are revealed within 5 cells of a detector unless a different radius is listed. Firing, taking damage or the specific ability's movement restriction also reveals them. Detector vehicles, every T2 escort and basic Watchtowers prevent concealment from becoming an uncounterable opening. EMP never changes ownership and never instantly kills an aircraft.

rule.combat.suppression_cover_and_smoke.title: Suppression, cover and smoke
rule.combat.suppression_cover_and_smoke.text: Suppression triggers after three designated suppressive hits within 2 seconds, reducing infantry movement by 25% for 3 seconds after the last hit. Fortress Guard fire and Watchtower fire are suppressive; other weapons are not unless later specified. Portable cover takes 4 seconds, lasts 45 seconds, allows one piece per builder and provides 20% bullet resistance unless stated otherwise. Marked civilian garrisons hold four infantry squads. Smoke uses the two-sided Dust Screen rule.

rule.combat.transports_aircraft_and_repa.title: Transports, aircraft and repairs
rule.combat.transports_aircraft_and_repa.text: Combat transports normally carry two infantry squads and cannot shoot with their passengers' weapons. Okapi carries three squads and Leviathan four; Kancil, Beaver, Naga and other APCs carry two. Aircraft need powered Airfield pads to rearm; carriers replenish only their own drones. Heal and repair auras from the same source do not stack. Field repair stations cannot repair themselves.

rule.combat.role_tags.title: Role tags
rule.combat.role_tags.text: Light means APC/scout chassis plus Sandglass, Scorpion and Reed artillery. Tank means direct-fire armored land combat units, including siege tanks, Ifrit, Kiln and Gaj, but not Dragon/Long command walkers or Leviathan transports. Artillery means indirect ground launchers, not direct-fire siege tanks, ships or aircraft. Unmanned means Firefly, Nest/Reed, Swallow, Silkwing, Nightjar and carrier-launched drones; not crewed carriers or temporary superweapon units.

rule.combat.submarines_and_wrecks.title: Submarines and wrecks
rule.combat.submarines_and_wrecks.text: Boreal Missile Submarines camouflage underwater and surface for 8 seconds when firing. Detectors reveal them; only anti-submarine weapons can target them underwater, while strategic blast damage still applies. Enemy land combat-vehicle wrecks persist for 60 seconds unless destroyed or salvaged; only the African Empire can turn them into credits. No salvage from friendly fire, deliberate scuttling or summons.

mechanical_conventions.interception_exception: Successful ordinary projectile interception removes the projectile; strategic impact packets have the specified partial-reduction rules.
mechanical_conventions.prerequisite_semantics: All IDs in requires_all_structure_ids must be present. Unit production also requires its producer, included in that list. Power activation adds operational/power conditions.

unit.def.ural_assault_tank.role_and_abilities: Heavy tank intercepting one incoming ordinary missile every 12 seconds. Cannot intercept shells, beams or superweapons; requires Radar.

unit.def.bear_siege_crawler.name: Bear Siege Crawler
unit.def.bear_siege_crawler.role_and_abilities: Very slow assault platform with frontal armor and a heavy demolition cannon. Poor vision and weak rear protection.

unit.def.steppe_recon_carrier.name: Steppe Recon Carrier
unit.def.steppe_recon_carrier.role_and_abilities: Fast light transport and detector with extended sight, but poor armor.

unit.def.saker_missile_truck.name: Saker Missile Truck
unit.def.saker_missile_truck.role_and_abilities: Precision anti-vehicle and anti-structure missile artillery; deploys in 1 second, with little splash.

unit.def.fortress_guard.name: Fortress Guard
unit.def.fortress_guard.role_and_abilities: Rifle squad that deploys in 3 seconds for stronger suppressive fire; cannot move while deployed.

unit.def.echo_team.name: Echo Team
unit.def.echo_team.role_and_abilities: Detector and suppression-recovery support. Can place one non-blocking decoy tank per team every 40 seconds; decoy lasts 30 seconds and has 1 health.

unit.pd.ranger_marine.name: Ranger Marine
unit.pd.ranger_marine.role_and_abilities: General infantry optimized for fighting after transport deployment.

unit.pd.harpoon_team.name: Harpoon Team
unit.pd.harpoon_team.role_and_abilities: Anti-vehicle missile infantry; may target surface ships, never aircraft.

unit.pd.reef_technician.name: Reef Technician
unit.pd.reef_technician.role_and_abilities: Unarmed specialist repairing nearby land vehicles or ships, one target at a time.

unit.pd.tide_tank.name: Tide Tank
unit.pd.tide_tank.role_and_abilities: Amphibious medium tank; slow movement on water.

unit.pd.storm_aa.name: Storm AA
unit.pd.storm_aa.role_and_abilities: Land-based anti-air and detector; requires a transport to cross water.

unit.pd.breaker_howitzer.name: Breaker Howitzer
unit.pd.breaker_howitzer.role_and_abilities: Conventional land artillery with good sustained fire.

unit.pd.leviathan_assault_carrier.name: Leviathan Assault Carrier
unit.pd.leviathan_assault_carrier.role_and_abilities: Heavy amphibious vehicle with a short-range siege cannon and infantry capacity.

unit.pd.petrel_fighter.name: Petrel Fighter
unit.pd.petrel_fighter.role_and_abilities: Dedicated interceptor with good patrol endurance.

unit.pd.osprey_strike_tiltrotor.name: Osprey Strike Tiltrotor
unit.pd.osprey_strike_tiltrotor.role_and_abilities: Anti-vehicle attack aircraft that hovers when firing; vulnerable to focused AA.

unit.pd.reef_patrol_boat.name: Reef Patrol Boat
unit.pd.reef_patrol_boat.role_and_abilities: Fast coastal scout and light-surface attacker.

unit.pd.tempest_carrier.name: Tempest Carrier
unit.pd.tempest_carrier.role_and_abilities: Launches short-range strike drones against ground or surface targets; needs escort protection.

unit.pd.outrider_howitzer.name: Outrider Howitzer
unit.pd.outrider_howitzer.role_and_abilities: Long-range mobile artillery with a narrow firing arc and 3-second deployment; weak at close range.

unit.pd.wedge_recon_fighter.name: Wedge Recon Fighter
unit.pd.wedge_recon_fighter.role_and_abilities: Detector-equipped fighter with extended sight; lower anti-air damage than Petrel.

unit.pd.kancil_landing_skimmer.name: Kancil Landing Skimmer
unit.pd.kancil_landing_skimmer.role_and_abilities: Fast amphibious light transport and detector. Passengers unload 50% faster; its weapon is weaker than Wake's.

unit.pd.island_raider.name: Island Raider
unit.pd.island_raider.role_and_abilities: Mobile rifle infantry gaining weapon damage +20% for 6 seconds after disembarking. The effect cannot be refreshed by immediate reboarding.

unit.pd.shinano_adaptive_tank.name: Shinano Adaptive Tank
unit.pd.shinano_adaptive_tank.role_and_abilities: Amphibious tank switching in 3 seconds between mobile direct fire and stationary long-range siege fire. Siege mode loses anti-infantry effectiveness.

unit.pd.shogun_drone_carrier.name: Shogun Drone Carrier
unit.pd.shogun_drone_carrier.role_and_abilities: Advanced carrier switching between surface-strike drones and interceptor drones; only one wing type may operate at a time.

unit.han.banner_infantry.name: Banner Infantry
unit.han.banner_infantry.role_and_abilities: Inexpensive general infantry; needs supporting weapons against armor.

unit.han.lance_team.name: Lance Team
unit.han.lance_team.role_and_abilities: Anti-vehicle rocket infantry with a long reload.

unit.han.link_operator.name: Link Operator
unit.han.link_operator.role_and_abilities: Unarmed detector and provider of the 5-cell command field.

unit.han.jade_carrier.name: Jade Carrier
unit.han.jade_carrier.role_and_abilities: Light transport and detector; vulnerable to direct tank fire.

unit.han.ox_tank.name: Ox Tank
unit.han.ox_tank.role_and_abilities: Simple medium tank used to screen infantry formations.

unit.han.firefly_aa_drone.name: Firefly AA Drone
unit.han.firefly_aa_drone.role_and_abilities: Unmanned mobile anti-air and detector; no useful anti-tank attack.

unit.han.nest_rocket_drone.name: Nest Rocket Drone
unit.han.nest_rocket_drone.role_and_abilities: Unmanned indirect-fire launcher; fragile and dependent on spotting.

unit.han.dragon_command_walker.name: Dragon Command Walker
unit.han.dragon_command_walker.role_and_abilities: Crewed heavy support vehicle with a cannon and 5-cell command field; expensive, large target.

unit.han.swallow_interceptor.name: Swallow Interceptor
unit.han.swallow_interceptor.role_and_abilities: Unmanned air-superiority fighter; cannot attack ground targets.

unit.han.silkwing_drone_bomber.name: Silkwing Drone Bomber
unit.han.silkwing_drone_bomber.role_and_abilities: Unmanned precision bomber with a slow rearm cycle.

unit.han.canal_patrol_boat.name: Canal Patrol Boat
unit.han.canal_patrol_boat.role_and_abilities: Cheap coastal scout and infantry support craft.

unit.han.emperor_drone_ship.name: Emperor Drone Ship
unit.han.emperor_drone_ship.role_and_abilities: Crewed carrier launching unmanned surface-strike drones; weak at close range.

unit.han.imperial_guard_tank.name: Imperial Guard Tank
unit.han.imperial_guard_tank.role_and_abilities: Better-armored medium tank with an accurate anti-vehicle gun; requires Radar and remains weak against infantry masses.

unit.han.long_command_walker.name: Long Command Walker
unit.han.long_command_walker.role_and_abilities: Heavy crewed command platform. Deploying in 3 seconds extends its command radius by 2 cells but prevents movement.

unit.han.canopy_ranger.name: Canopy Ranger
unit.han.canopy_ranger.role_and_abilities: Rifle infantry camouflaging after 6 seconds stationary without firing on any terrain. Moving, attacking or taking damage reveals it.

unit.han.reed_rocket_skimmer.name: Reed Rocket Skimmer
unit.han.reed_rocket_skimmer.role_and_abilities: Unmanned amphibious light artillery firing short rocket bursts; less range and health than Nest.

unit.han.lotus_drone_tender.name: Lotus Drone Tender
unit.han.lotus_drone_tender.role_and_abilities: Light transport and detector. Repairs one nearby friendly unmanned land unit at 1% maximum health per second, paying normal repair cost; cannot repair itself.

unit.han.mekong_field_engineer.name: Mekong Field Engineer
unit.han.mekong_field_engineer.role_and_abilities: Unarmed detector, structure repairer and command provider. Its command field requires a 2-second stationary deployment; service Engineers remain available.

unit.ae.union_guard.name: Union Guard
unit.ae.union_guard.role_and_abilities: Reliable general infantry protecting repair and salvage teams.

unit.ae.pike_team.name: Pike Team
unit.ae.pike_team.role_and_abilities: Anti-tank infantry with a short-to-medium-range missile.

unit.ae.reclaimer.name: Reclaimer
unit.ae.reclaimer.role_and_abilities: Armed salvage specialist; repairs one land vehicle at normal Engineer rate and gains salvage access.

unit.ae.mamba_apc.name: Mamba APC
unit.ae.mamba_apc.role_and_abilities: Wheeled light transport and detector; strong road mobility.

unit.ae.buffalo_tank.name: Buffalo Tank
unit.ae.buffalo_tank.role_and_abilities: Conventional medium tank designed for repair and reuse.

unit.ae.weaver_aa.name: Weaver AA
unit.ae.weaver_aa.role_and_abilities: Mobile anti-air and detector with poor anti-armor capability.

unit.ae.forge_howitzer.name: Forge Howitzer
unit.ae.forge_howitzer.role_and_abilities: Durable indirect artillery with shorter range than most rivals.

unit.ae.kiln_assault_crawler.name: Kiln Assault Crawler
unit.ae.kiln_assault_crawler.role_and_abilities: Heavy demolition vehicle with a broad blast and short reach.

unit.ae.sunbird_interceptor.name: Sunbird Interceptor
unit.ae.sunbird_interceptor.role_and_abilities: Dedicated fighter protecting advancing ground formations.

unit.ae.hammerhead_gunship.name: Hammerhead Gunship
unit.ae.hammerhead_gunship.role_and_abilities: Close-support anti-vehicle aircraft, vulnerable to prepared AA.

unit.ae.delta_patrol_boat.name: Delta Patrol Boat
unit.ae.delta_patrol_boat.role_and_abilities: River and coastal scout with a light cannon.

unit.ae.sovereign_arsenal_ship.name: Sovereign Arsenal Ship
unit.ae.sovereign_arsenal_ship.role_and_abilities: Heavy naval artillery platform with limited mobility.

unit.ae.civic_rifle_team.name: Civic Rifle Team
unit.ae.civic_rifle_team.role_and_abilities: Rifle infantry able to place one 20-second sensor puck every 30 seconds. Puck reveals a 4-cell area but does not detect camouflage and is destructible.

unit.ae.lagos_drone_guard.name: Lagos Drone Guard
unit.ae.lagos_drone_guard.role_and_abilities: Mobile anti-air and detector with one small repair drone. The drone repairs one nearby infantry unit at 1% maximum health per second and can be shot down.

unit.ae.okapi_amphibious_carrier.name: Okapi Amphibious Carrier
unit.ae.okapi_amphibious_carrier.role_and_abilities: Amphibious light transport and detector; thin armor but strong passenger capacity.

unit.ae.river_warden.name: River Warden
unit.ae.river_warden.role_and_abilities: Armed repair and salvage infantry. Camouflages after 6 seconds stationary; repairing, salvaging or firing reveals it.

unit.ae.rhino_rail_tank.name: Rhino Rail Tank
unit.ae.rhino_rail_tank.role_and_abilities: Accurate anti-armor rail tank with little splash; requires Radar and cannot efficiently clear infantry alone.

unit.ae.protea_gun_carrier.name: Protea Gun Carrier
unit.ae.protea_gun_carrier.role_and_abilities: Switches in 3 seconds between indirect siege shells and short-range defensive canister fire; cannot use both simultaneously.

unit.sap.shield_rifle_squad.name: Shield Rifle Squad
unit.sap.shield_rifle_squad.role_and_abilities: General infantry with good staying power behind cover.

unit.sap.kavach_team.name: Kavach Team
unit.sap.kavach_team.role_and_abilities: Anti-vehicle missile infantry; cannot fire on the move.

unit.sap.combat_pioneer.name: Combat Pioneer
unit.sap.combat_pioneer.role_and_abilities: Armed engineer building temporary cover and repairing defenses; cannot capture structures.

unit.sap.jackal_apc.name: Jackal APC
unit.sap.jackal_apc.role_and_abilities: Light transport and detector with modest armor.

unit.sap.bulwark_tank.name: Bulwark Tank
unit.sap.bulwark_tank.role_and_abilities: Slow medium tank supporting infantry advances.

unit.sap.monsoon_howitzer.name: Monsoon Howitzer
unit.sap.monsoon_howitzer.role_and_abilities: Steady indirect artillery with a 3-second deployment.

unit.sap.elephant_siege_tank.name: Elephant Siege Tank
unit.sap.elephant_siege_tank.role_and_abilities: Heavy assault gun with strong anti-structure damage and slow traverse.

unit.sap.garuda_interceptor.name: Garuda Interceptor
unit.sap.garuda_interceptor.role_and_abilities: Dedicated defensive fighter with good endurance.

unit.sap.sarus_gunship.name: Sarus Gunship
unit.sap.sarus_gunship.role_and_abilities: Close-support anti-vehicle aircraft with a short effective range.

unit.sap.estuary_patrol_boat.name: Estuary Patrol Boat
unit.sap.estuary_patrol_boat.role_and_abilities: River and coastal scout with a light cannon.

unit.sap.citadel_monitor.name: Citadel Monitor
unit.sap.citadel_monitor.role_and_abilities: Armored coastal artillery ship, slow and vulnerable without escorts.

unit.sap.arjun_assault_tank.name: Arjun Assault Tank
unit.sap.arjun_assault_tank.role_and_abilities: Armored medium tank mounting a short-range active-protection system. It intercepts one ordinary missile every 15 seconds; requires Radar.

unit.sap.gaj_siege_platform.name: Gaj Siege Platform
unit.sap.gaj_siege_platform.role_and_abilities: Heavy siege vehicle that deploys in 4 seconds for weapon range +20% and cannot move while deployed.

unit.sap.naga_amphibious_carrier.name: Naga Amphibious Carrier
unit.sap.naga_amphibious_carrier.role_and_abilities: Amphibious light transport and detector with a smoke launcher: one 4-cell-radius, 6-second shared-rule smoke screen every 40 seconds.

unit.sap.river_marine.name: River Marine
unit.sap.river_marine.role_and_abilities: Rifle infantry taking 20% less weapon damage for 6 seconds after disembarking. Immediate reboarding cannot refresh the effect.

unit.sap.shaheen_missile_battery.name: Shaheen Missile Battery
unit.sap.shaheen_missile_battery.role_and_abilities: Precision missile artillery requiring 3 seconds to deploy; long reach, small blast radius and vulnerable during reload.

unit.sap.watchpost_recon_team.name: Watchpost Recon Team
unit.sap.watchpost_recon_team.role_and_abilities: Detector and artillery observer that camouflages after 6 stationary seconds. Cannot build cover or repair defenses.

research.napc.adaptive_plating.name: Adaptive Plating
research.napc.adaptive_plating.effect_text: Land combat vehicles take 10% less explosive damage. Does not reduce beam, rail or bullet damage.

research.napc.joint_tactical_links.name: Joint Tactical Links
research.napc.joint_tactical_links.effect_text: Sentinel AA and Aegis Frigates gain weapon range +10% while within 6 cells of a friendly Rifle Squad, Javelin Team or their replacements.

research.napc.dispersed_runways.name: Dispersed Runways
research.napc.dispersed_runways.effect_text: Airfields gain two extra service pads; service rate per pad is unchanged.

research.napc.sealed_compartments.name: Sealed Compartments
research.napc.sealed_compartments.effect_text: Beaver and Narwhal units take 15% less explosive damage while on water.

research.napc.section_logistics.name: Section Logistics
research.napc.section_logistics.effect_text: Combat infantry recover 1% maximum health per second near a powered Barracks after 6 seconds out of combat.

research.nec.sensor_fusion.name: Sensor Fusion
research.nec.sensor_fusion.effect_text: Surveyor APC, Rapier AA and Horizon Escort detection radius +2 cells; replacements inherit it.

research.nec.distributed_control.name: Distributed Control
research.nec.distributed_control.effect_text: Relay radius increases from 6 to 8 cells. A Relay retains its damage-bonus field for 10 seconds after losing power, but not after destruction.

research.nec.dispersed_links.name: Dispersed Links
research.nec.dispersed_links.effect_text: Deployed Fen masts provide the Relay damage bonus in 4 cells using onboard power. Fields work during base power loss, do not stack with Relays and do not gain Relay radius upgrades.

research.nec.shared_fire_solutions.name: Shared Fire Solutions
research.nec.shared_fire_solutions.effect_text: Marte and Charlemagne gain reload interval -10% inside a powered Relay field.

research.nec.tunnel_workshops.name: Tunnel Workshops
research.nec.tunnel_workshops.effect_text: Engineers and Alpine Pioneers repair defensive structures 25% faster; credit cost per health restored is unchanged.

research.olm.thermal_shrouds.name: Thermal Shrouds
research.olm.thermal_shrouds.effect_text: Light land vehicles gain sight +10% and take 10% less thermal-beam damage.

research.olm.optical_mesh.name: Optical Mesh
research.olm.optical_mesh.effect_text: Caravan APCs and their replacements camouflage after 6 seconds stationary without attacking. Moving or firing reveals them.

research.olm.thermal_reservoirs.name: Thermal Reservoirs
research.olm.thermal_reservoirs.effect_text: Ifrit and Dawn units gain reload or cooling interval -10%; does not alter Helios.

research.olm.distributed_fuel_caches.name: Distributed Fuel Caches
research.olm.distributed_fuel_caches.effect_text: Dune Rovers and Scorpions gain movement speed +10% after 6 seconds out of combat; firing or taking damage ends it.

research.olm.harbor_militia.name: Harbor Militia
research.olm.harbor_militia.effect_text: Gate Guards gain damage +10% within 6 cells of a friendly Factory or Dock; no stacking between buildings.

research.def.standardized_parts.name: Standardized Parts
research.def.standardized_parts.effect_text: Engineer repairs to land vehicles cost 15% fewer credits per health restored; applies anywhere, not only near a Factory.

research.def.coordinated_barrages.name: Coordinated Barrages
research.def.coordinated_barrages.effect_text: Anvil batteries, Colossus tanks and their replacements gain reload interval -10% when stationary for at least 4 seconds. Moving resets the bonus.

research.def.layered_protection.name: Layered Protection
research.def.layered_protection.effect_text: Ural missile-interception cooldown falls from 12 to 9 seconds; Bear gains one such interceptor.

research.def.mobile_dispatch.name: Mobile Dispatch
research.def.mobile_dispatch.effect_text: Steppe Carriers and Saker trucks gain sight +15% and pack up without delay after firing.

research.def.buried_command_lines.name: Buried Command Lines
research.def.buried_command_lines.effect_text: Radar and defensive structures recover from EMP shutdown 25% sooner; does not prevent initial shutdown.

research.pd.expeditionary_maintenance.name: Expeditionary Maintenance
research.pd.expeditionary_maintenance.effect_text: Reef Technicians repair 25% faster. Repair credit cost per health restored is unchanged.

research.pd.integrated_flight_decks.name: Integrated Flight Decks
research.pd.integrated_flight_decks.effect_text: Airfield rearm time -15%; carrier drone replacement time -15%. Applies to carrier replacements.

research.pd.forward_fire_control.name: Forward Fire Control
research.pd.forward_fire_control.effect_text: Outriders gain reload interval -10% while their target is within 6 cells of a friendly Wedge Recon Fighter.

research.pd.distributed_beachheads.name: Distributed Beachheads
research.pd.distributed_beachheads.effect_text: Reef Technicians gain movement speed +15% and can repair a transport while riding in it, one Technician per transport.

research.pd.predictive_maintenance.name: Predictive Maintenance
research.pd.predictive_maintenance.effect_text: Shinano mode changes take 2 seconds; Shogun drone replacement time -20%.

research.han.resilient_mesh.name: Resilient Mesh
research.han.resilient_mesh.effect_text: Unmanned combat units recover from EMP weapon shutdown 25% sooner; they still take normal EMP damage.

research.han.distributed_cognition.name: Distributed Cognition
research.han.distributed_cognition.effect_text: Command-field radius increases from 5 to 7 cells. Bonuses still do not stack and no unit is useful only inside a field.

research.han.guard_integration.name: Guard Integration
research.han.guard_integration.effect_text: Imperial Guard Tanks count as eligible recipients of command-field damage bonuses, despite being crewed.

research.han.hidden_relays.name: Hidden Relays
research.han.hidden_relays.effect_text: Link Operators camouflage after 6 seconds stationary without attacking; their command field remains active while hidden.

research.han.modular_servicing.name: Modular Servicing
research.han.modular_servicing.effect_text: Lotus Tenders repair 50% faster, but credit cost per health restored is unchanged.

research.ae.recovery_winches.name: Recovery Winches
research.ae.recovery_winches.effect_text: Salvage actions take 5 rather than 8 seconds. Wreck value is unchanged.

research.ae.circular_armor.name: Circular Armor
research.ae.circular_armor.effect_text: Land combat vehicles gain health +10%. Does not create salvage from friendly losses or increase a wreck's paid-cost basis.

research.ae.municipal_reserves.name: Municipal Reserves
research.ae.municipal_reserves.effect_text: Civic Rifle Teams gain health +10% within 6 cells of a friendly Barracks or Refinery; fields do not stack.

research.ae.watershed_logistics.name: Watershed Logistics
research.ae.watershed_logistics.effect_text: Okapi carriers repair carried infantry at 1% maximum health per second after 6 seconds out of combat; free healing does not repair the carrier.

research.ae.precision_machining.name: Precision Machining
research.ae.precision_machining.effect_text: Rhino and Protea reload intervals -10%; applies in either Protea firing mode.

research.sap.layered_fieldworks.name: Layered Fieldworks
research.sap.layered_fieldworks.effect_text: Combat infantry within 4 cells of a friendly defensive structure take 10% less explosive damage; overlapping structures do not stack.

research.sap.reserve_capacitors.name: Reserve Capacitors
research.sap.reserve_capacitors.effect_text: Defense power reserve increases from 20 to 35 seconds. Recharge still requires 60 continuous seconds of adequate power.

research.sap.integrated_protection.name: Integrated Protection
research.sap.integrated_protection.effect_text: Arjun missile-interception cooldown falls from 15 to 10 seconds; Gaj gains one interceptor with the same cooldown.

research.sap.rapid_ferry_drills.name: Rapid Ferry Drills
research.sap.rapid_ferry_drills.effect_text: Naga loading and unloading time -40%; does not change passenger attack speed.

research.sap.observer_network.name: Observer Network
research.sap.observer_network.effect_text: Shaheen batteries gain reload interval -10% when their target is within 6 cells of a Watchpost team.

power.napc.uav_sweep.name: UAV Sweep
power.napc.uav_sweep.effect_text: A shootable reconnaissance UAV circles a 7-cell-radius area for 12 seconds, revealing terrain and detecting concealed units.

power.napc.field_repair_drop.name: Field Repair Drop
power.napc.field_repair_drop.effect_text: A shootable cargo aircraft delivers a repair station. It repairs friendly land vehicles in 5 cells by 2% maximum health per second for 10 seconds; stations do not stack.

power.napc.combined_arms_window.name: Combined Arms Window
power.napc.combined_arms_window.effect_text: For 15 seconds, friendly infantry, land vehicles and aircraft in a selected 6-cell-radius zone deal 10% more weapon damage. Ships and structures receive no bonus.

power.napc.rapid_turnaround.name: Rapid Turnaround
power.napc.rapid_turnaround.effect_text: One powered Airfield rearms aircraft 50% faster for 20 seconds. Does not accelerate aircraft production.

power.napc.floating_workshop.name: Floating Workshop
power.napc.floating_workshop.effect_text: Deploy a visible repair pontoon on clear land or water. For 20 seconds it repairs friendly vehicles and ships within 5 cells at 1.5% maximum health per second.

power.napc.coordinated_advance.name: Coordinated Advance
power.napc.coordinated_advance.effect_text: Friendly infantry in a 6-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +25% and suppression immunity for 12 seconds. Existing suppression is removed.

power.nec.survey_drone.name: Survey Drone
power.nec.survey_drone.effect_text: A shootable drone reveals and detects within 6 cells of the target for 15 seconds.

power.nec.counterbattery_mission.name: Counterbattery Mission
power.nec.counterbattery_mission.effect_text: After 5 seconds of warning, six conventional precision shells strike a selected 4-cell-radius area over 4 seconds. Moderate siege damage; moving units can escape.

power.nec.treaty_coordination.name: Treaty Coordination
power.nec.treaty_coordination.effect_text: For 20 seconds, powered Relays provide damage +15% instead of +10%. No additional benefit outside their fields.

power.nec.silent_watch.name: Silent Watch
power.nec.silent_watch.effect_text: Friendly stationary ground units in a 6-cell-radius area camouflage for up to 15 seconds. Movement, firing or detection breaks concealment.

power.nec.armored_overwatch.name: Armored Overwatch
power.nec.armored_overwatch.effect_text: For 15 seconds, stationary tanks in a selected 6-cell-radius zone gain weapon range +10%. Moving immediately removes the bonus.

power.nec.emergency_earthworks.name: Emergency Earthworks
power.nec.emergency_earthworks.effect_text: Friendly infantry and defenses in a 5-cell-radius zone take 20% less explosive damage for 15 seconds. Does not protect vehicles.

power.olm.dust_screen.name: Dust Screen
power.olm.dust_screen.effect_text: A 6-cell-radius smoke zone lasts 12 seconds. All ground units inside, friendly or enemy, take 30% less direct-fire weapon damage; artillery and area blasts are unaffected.

power.olm.mobile_workshop.name: Mobile Workshop
power.olm.mobile_workshop.effect_text: Place a visible, destructible repair drone station on clear ground. It repairs friendly vehicles in 5 cells at 2% maximum health per second for 15 seconds; no stacking.

power.olm.open_corridor.name: Open Corridor
power.olm.open_corridor.effect_text: Friendly land vehicles in a selected 6-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +25% for 12 seconds. Units must be in the zone when activated.

power.olm.capacitor_discharge.name: Capacitor Discharge
power.olm.capacitor_discharge.effect_text: Thermal-beam units and Sunwall defenses in a 6-cell-radius zone deal damage +20% for 10 seconds, then cannot fire for 4 seconds while cooling.

power.olm.false_convoy.name: False Convoy
power.olm.false_convoy.effect_text: Create four visible decoy light vehicles for 25 seconds at a scouted clear location. They have 1 health, no damage, no collision and no capture ability; detectors identify them.

power.olm.straits_crossfire.name: Straits Crossfire
power.olm.straits_crossfire.effect_text: Friendly infantry and ships in a selected 6-cell-radius zone gain weapon range +10% and sight +20% for 15 seconds.

power.def.mobilization_order.name: Mobilization Order
power.def.mobilization_order.effect_text: For 20 seconds, Barracks and Factory production progresses 25% faster. Costs remain unchanged; benefit applies only while this power is active.

power.def.tremor_barrage.name: Tremor Barrage
power.def.tremor_barrage.effect_text: After a 6-second warning, four waves of conventional shells strike a 5-cell-radius area over 8 seconds. High area pressure, limited precision.

power.def.redundant_orders.name: Redundant Orders
power.def.redundant_orders.effect_text: Friendly vehicles in a 6-cell-radius zone ignore weapon-disabling EMP effects for 10 seconds. Does not protect buildings or prevent damage.

power.def.steel_advance.name: Steel Advance
power.def.steel_advance.effect_text: Land vehicles in a 6-cell-radius zone take 20% less weapon damage for 12 seconds, but movement speed is reduced by a further 20% during the effect.

power.def.transit_priority.name: Transit Priority
power.def.transit_priority.effect_text: Friendly collectors and ground transports in a 7-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +35% for 15 seconds. Does not improve harvesting or unloading rate.

power.def.false_front.name: False Front
power.def.false_front.effect_text: Place a 30-second decoy Radar and three decoy tanks in a scouted 6-cell zone. All are harmless, non-blocking and revealed by detectors.

power.pd.maritime_patrol.name: Maritime Patrol
power.pd.maritime_patrol.effect_text: A shootable patrol aircraft reveals and detects a 20-cell-long, 6-cell-wide corridor for 12 seconds. Works over land and water.

power.pd.expeditionary_workshop.name: Expeditionary Workshop
power.pd.expeditionary_workshop.effect_text: A shootable aircraft drops a 20-second workshop on clear land or water, repairing friendly vehicles and ships in 5 cells at 1.5% maximum health per second.

power.pd.joint_landing.name: Joint Landing
power.pd.joint_landing.effect_text: For 15 seconds, friendly ground units that disembark from transports take 20% less weapon damage for 6 seconds. Reboarding cannot refresh an existing protection effect.

power.pd.long_watch.name: Long Watch
power.pd.long_watch.effect_text: Reveal a 7-cell-radius area for 18 seconds through a high-altitude sensor pass. It reveals terrain and ordinary units but does not detect camouflage.

power.pd.feint_landing.name: Feint Landing
power.pd.feint_landing.effect_text: Create three harmless, non-blocking decoy transports for 25 seconds on scouted land or water. They cannot carry units and are identified by detectors.

power.pd.precision_window.name: Precision Window
power.pd.precision_window.effect_text: Friendly aircraft and ships in a 6-cell-radius zone gain weapon damage +20% for 10 seconds, but receive no bonus to sight or survivability.

power.han.wideband_scan.name: Wideband Scan
power.han.wideband_scan.effect_text: Reveal and detect a 7-cell-radius area for 6 seconds. A visible scan warning gives opponents 2 seconds before detection begins.

power.han.software_surge.name: Software Surge
power.han.software_surge.effect_text: Friendly unmanned combat units in a 6-cell-radius zone gain reload interval -25% for 12 seconds, then lose weapons for 3 seconds. Excludes superweapon summons.

power.han.reserve_bandwidth.name: Reserve Bandwidth
power.han.reserve_bandwidth.effect_text: For 20 seconds, all surviving command-field providers gain radius +3 cells. Damage bonus stays at +10% and overlapping fields still do not stack.

power.han.central_priority.name: Central Priority
power.han.central_priority.effect_text: For 15 seconds, command fields provide weapon damage +20% instead of +10%; their radius is unchanged.

power.han.broken_contact.name: Broken Contact
power.han.broken_contact.effect_text: Ground combat units in a 6-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +20% for 10 seconds and leave a 6-second smoke screen at their initial position. Smoke follows the shared Dust Screen rule.

power.han.repair_swarm.name: Repair Swarm
power.han.repair_swarm.effect_text: Repair friendly unmanned land units and structures in a 5-cell-radius zone by 2% maximum health per second for 10 seconds. This paid power has no further repair charge.

power.ae.survey_network.name: Survey Network
power.ae.survey_network.effect_text: Reveal a 7-cell-radius area for 12 seconds and highlight salvageable wrecks there. Reveals ordinary units but does not detect camouflage.

power.ae.field_refurbishment.name: Field Refurbishment
power.ae.field_refurbishment.effect_text: Repair friendly land vehicles in a 6-cell-radius zone by 3% maximum health per second for 10 seconds. They cannot fire while receiving repairs; moving ends repair on that unit.

power.ae.recovery_priority.name: Recovery Priority
power.ae.recovery_priority.effect_text: For 20 seconds, Engineers and Reclaimers gain movement speed +25% and salvage in 3 seconds. Salvage payout is unchanged.

power.ae.civil_defense_net.name: Civil Defense Net
power.ae.civil_defense_net.effect_text: Friendly infantry in a 6-cell-radius area gain sight +25% and suppression immunity for 15 seconds.

power.ae.concealed_crossing.name: Concealed Crossing
power.ae.concealed_crossing.effect_text: Lay a 16-cell-long, 4-cell-wide smoke corridor on land or water for 12 seconds. It follows the shared Dust Screen damage rule and protects either side.

power.ae.counterbattery_solution.name: Counterbattery Solution
power.ae.counterbattery_solution.effect_text: Reveal enemy artillery that fired during the preceding 8 seconds within a selected 9-cell area, then mark those units for 12 seconds. Friendly ground weapons deal +15% damage to marked targets.

power.sap.recon_balloon.name: Recon Balloon
power.sap.recon_balloon.effect_text: Deploy a shootable tethered observation drone at a clear location for 20 seconds. It reveals terrain and detects within 6 cells.

power.sap.emergency_fortification.name: Emergency Fortification
power.sap.emergency_fortification.effect_text: Friendly defenses and production buildings in a 6-cell-radius zone take 25% less weapon damage for 15 seconds. Does not protect the superweapon structure or prevent EMP.

power.sap.protected_advance.name: Protected Advance
power.sap.protected_advance.effect_text: For 12 seconds, infantry and land vehicles in a selected 6-cell-radius zone take 15% less weapon damage. Units receive no movement bonus.

power.sap.assault_coordination.name: Assault Coordination
power.sap.assault_coordination.effect_text: Friendly tanks in a 6-cell-radius zone gain reload interval -15% and sight +15% for 12 seconds.

power.sap.mobile_reserve.name: Mobile Reserve
power.sap.mobile_reserve.effect_text: Friendly ground transports in a 7-cell-radius zone gain movement speed +30% for 15 seconds and may unload while moving at half speed.

power.sap.counterlaunch_plot.name: Counterlaunch Plot
power.sap.counterlaunch_plot.effect_text: Mark enemy artillery that fired in the last 8 seconds inside a selected 8-cell-radius zone. After a 5-second warning, conventional shells hit the marked positions, not the units' new locations.

superweapon.napc.atlas_kinetic_array.name: Atlas Kinetic Array
superweapon.napc.atlas_kinetic_array.effect_text: A surviving orbital magazine releases three guided kinetic penetrators at a selected point and two points 3 cells to either side. Each has a 2-cell damage radius. It is strongest against clustered heavy vehicles and key buildings; the gaps and long warning reward dispersal.
superweapon.napc.atlas_kinetic_array.counterplay: Move valuable units between the impact circles, spread essential buildings, or destroy the control structure before the warning expires.

superweapon.nec.aurora_microwave_array.name: Aurora Microwave Array
superweapon.nec.aurora_microwave_array.effect_text: A microwave burst affects an 8-cell-radius zone. Enemy vehicles and aircraft lose weapons for 8 seconds; powered enemy structures shut down for 18 seconds. Vehicles can still move, aircraft do not crash, and infantry remain operational. Direct damage is light.
superweapon.nec.aurora_microwave_array.counterplay: Disperse powered infrastructure, advance with infantry, and retreat disabled vehicles. Destroying Aurora during its warning cancels the pulse.

superweapon.olm.helios_reflector.name: Helios Reflector
superweapon.olm.helios_reflector.effect_text: A surviving orbital mirror focuses sunlight along a player-selected line 16 cells long and 3 cells wide. The beam traverses the line over 12 seconds, damaging ground units, ships and structures with strong thermal damage. It cannot track units after the line is committed.
superweapon.olm.helios_reflector.counterplay: Leave the marked line, attack along its flanks, and spread structures. Beam-resistant upgrades reduce its damage; smoke does not.

superweapon.def.perun_missile_complex.name: Perun Missile Complex
superweapon.def.perun_missile_complex.effect_text: One conventional bunker-buster missile detonates in a 3-cell-radius core, followed by a lower-damage fragmentation ring out to 7 cells. The core threatens heavy structures; the ring punishes tightly packed support units. It leaves no permanent contamination.
superweapon.def.perun_missile_complex.counterplay: Move away from the central marker, separate production buildings and intercept the attack by destroying the launch complex during its warning. Normal AA cannot stop the strategic missile.

superweapon.pd.tempest_swarm_hub.name: Tempest Swarm Hub
superweapon.pd.tempest_swarm_hub.effect_text: Launches 24 autonomous strike drones toward a selected 6-cell-radius area. They attack ground and surface targets there for up to 20 seconds before their batteries expire. Drones are individually targetable by AA and their approach direction is visible. Maximum aggregate damage is high, but interception can sharply reduce it.
superweapon.pd.tempest_swarm_hub.counterplay: Concentrate overlapping AA near the marked zone, move mobile units out, or destroy the hub during the warning. Drones cannot capture, scout beyond their attack zone or be salvaged.

superweapon.han.dragonfall_field_foundry.name: Dragonfall Field Foundry
superweapon.han.dragonfall_field_foundry.effect_text: Three assembly capsules land within a marked 5-cell-radius area, then take 5 seconds to unfold into autonomous siege engines. They can be attacked during assembly. For 60 seconds after assembly they operate as slow anti-structure ground units, then their limited-energy cores expire. They cannot capture, repair, harvest, receive command-field buffs or generate salvage.
superweapon.han.dragonfall_field_foundry.counterplay: Attack capsules before assembly, surround the slow engines with anti-tank units, or retreat and wait out their 60-second lifetime. Destroying the Foundry during warning cancels deployment.

superweapon.ae.horizon_mass_driver.name: Horizon Mass Driver
superweapon.ae.horizon_mass_driver.effect_text: A rail-assisted strategic battery strikes three overlapping circles, each 3 cells in radius, along a 10-cell line over 9 seconds. Impacts damage ground units, ships and structures. On land, pulverized debris slows all land vehicles by 35% for 20 seconds and prevents new construction there; it never blocks movement or permanently changes the map.
superweapon.ae.horizon_mass_driver.counterplay: Leave the marked line before the first impact, avoid routing reinforcements through the debris, and attack from the sides. Existing buildings remain usable if they survive.

superweapon.sap.trident_interception_arr.name: Trident Interception Array
superweapon.sap.trident_interception_arr.effect_text: Protects a selected 6-cell-radius zone for 25 seconds with 24 interception charges. Each incoming hostile ordinary missile or artillery shell crossing the boundary consumes one charge and is destroyed. A superweapon impact packet consumes 8 charges to reduce its damage by 50%, never to cancel it. Beams, bullets, EMP, units entering the zone and weapons fired from inside it bypass interception. The zone is fixed and clearly visible.
superweapon.sap.trident_interception_arr.counterplay: Exhaust charges with cheap projectiles, attack with beams or infantry, enter the zone, or wait 25 seconds. Protection can support an offensive push; it is not a permanent base shield.

faction.napc.name: North American Peace Corps
faction.napc.motto: Hold the line. Bring them home.
faction.napc.lore: After the Long Blackout, North American evacuation commands became the only institutions able to keep continental supply routes open. Their emergency charter hardened into the North American Peace Corps, a military reconstruction alliance rather than the historical civilian organization. Its elected Assembly promises to reopen the Meridian Network under public supervision. Generals argue that the network must first be secured by force. Communities grateful for restored power increasingly question why temporary military administrations never leave.
faction.napc.identity: Durable combined arms; reliable frontline vehicles and recovery.
faction.napc.visual_direction: Olive, cream and rescue orange; broad hulls, modular armor, visible crew cabins.
traits_text: Land combat vehicles: health +10%, purchase cost +10%.
Factory service apron: friendly land combat vehicles within 5 cells recover 1% maximum health per second, up to 75%, after 6 seconds without dealing or taking damage. Multiple aprons do not stack.
Strengths: dependable armor, repair efficiency, clear combined-arms roles. Weaknesses: expensive vehicle losses and limited concealment.
faction.napc.opening: Rifle Squad and Pathfinder scout first; two Guardians secure the first expansion. Add Sentinel AA before committing to Paladins. Preserve damaged vehicles instead of trading them.
faction.napc.counterplay: Raid collectors while the main army repairs, attack from several directions, and use cheaper anti-tank units to punish heavy-vehicle concentration.

faction.nec.name: New European Confederation
faction.nec.lore: The old continental institutions failed when member governments seized their own power reserves. City leagues, surviving national services and industrial cooperatives later negotiated a new confederation with narrow but enforceable obligations. Its armies defend a dense lattice of shared sensors and guaranteed supply routes. The Confederation wants Meridian governed by treaty and transparent technical standards, yet its smaller members fear that the engineers who define those standards will quietly become the new rulers.
faction.nec.identity: Precision, sensor networks and deliberate positional warfare.
faction.nec.visual_direction: Slate blue, white and amber; low profiles, angular turrets, fold-out sensor masts.
traits_text: Networked fire: friendly combat infantry and land combat vehicles within 6 cells of a powered friendly Relay deal weapon damage +10%. Relay fields do not stack.
All combat units cost +5%; service units are exempt.
Strengths: precise fire, strong defensive positions and efficient local coordination. Weaknesses: costly units and dependence on vulnerable Relay coverage.
faction.nec.opening: Establish one contested position with Jagers and Leopards; add Radar, a Relay and Rapiers. Use artillery to make opponents enter the network rather than chasing blindly.
faction.nec.counterplay: Attack the network edges, disable power, force repeated repositioning and use cheap units to absorb slow precision volleys.

faction.olm.name: Order of the Levant and Mediterranean
faction.olm.motto: Keep the wells. Keep the word.
faction.olm.lore: Desalination operators, Levantine municipal councils and Mediterranean convoy leagues created an oath-bound order to defend water and energy infrastructure during the Blackout. Membership is civic and includes many faiths and secular communities. The Order now protects a chain of coastal enclaves rather than a continuous empire. It argues that no distant government should be able to shut off another city's water. Its solar directorates nevertheless want exclusive custody of the very Meridian controls that would make such coercion possible.
faction.olm.identity: Mobile combined arms, concealment and abundant electrical power.
faction.olm.visual_direction: Ivory, copper and deep teal; heat shields, fabric screens and articulated wheels.
traits_text: Combat infantry and light land vehicles: movement speed +10%, health -10%.
Generators produce +25% power; this creates no credits.
Strengths: rapid repositioning, screening and energy-intensive systems. Weaknesses: fragile screens and poor prolonged frontal trades.
faction.olm.opening: Use Caravan and Sirocco groups to threaten several routes, screen retreats with Dust Screen, and bring Observers before attempting a siege.
faction.olm.counterplay: Keep a mobile reserve, force close fights, detect concealed observers and attack the thin frontline before energy weapons can concentrate.

faction.def.name: Democratic Eurasian Federation
faction.def.motto: A thousand districts. One supply line.
faction.def.lore: The Federation emerged from emergency congresses linking surviving Russian regions, Kazakh transport authorities and the northern Korean industrial state. Its charter distributes representation among territorial and workplace assemblies, but wartime production quotas give the central supply ministry enormous power. Some districts defend the federation as their only protection from abandonment; others call its elections ceremonial. It wants Meridian reopened as a shared industrial backbone and is willing to occupy reluctant junction cities to make the plan function.
faction.def.identity: Industrial volume, artillery saturation and replaceable armored forces.
faction.def.visual_direction: Oxide red, gray and pale yellow; slab armor, exposed running gear and standardized containers.
traits_text: Land combat vehicles: cost -10%, build time -10%, movement speed -10%.
No free units, permanent production multiplier or unlimited passive income; numerical superiority still needs collectors and factories.
Strengths: replacement capacity, heavy artillery and sustained pressure. Weaknesses: slow reactions, supply exposure and cumbersome late-game formations.
faction.def.opening: Use cheap Hammers and infantry to contest two fronts, establish the economy behind them, then build a screened Anvil line rather than rushing one expensive capstone.
faction.def.counterplay: Attack collectors, force artillery to redeploy, strike several fronts and avoid engaging the entire production stream head-on.

faction.pd.name: Pacific Dominion
faction.pd.lore: Australia, Indonesian maritime leagues and Japanese industrial authorities kept each other alive through a chain of protected shipping routes. Their emergency maritime command became the Pacific Dominion: a treaty government whose authority is strongest at sea and contested on land. Its admirals want Meridian reopened without allowing a continental power to dictate access to ports. Smaller islands increasingly ask whether the Dominion's promise of open passage includes the right to refuse its bases.
faction.pd.identity: Amphibious maneuver, naval reach and flexible coastal logistics.
faction.pd.visual_direction: Ocean blue, coral orange and white; sealed hulls, folding flight surfaces and deck-mounted drones.
traits_text: Collectors are amphibious and can cross navigable water at 70% of their land speed. They still collect only from designated deposits and unload at a Refinery.
Ships gain movement speed +15%.
Defensive structures have health -15%. Strengths: alternative routes and mobile staging. Weaknesses: vulnerable fixed positions and costly losses during landings.
faction.pd.opening: Use Wake Skimmers and Tide Tanks to threaten routes that conventional armies cannot cover cheaply; build enough Storm AA to protect the landing area before investing in a fleet.
faction.pd.counterplay: Guard landing exits, attack weak static defenses and keep aircraft ready to strike isolated amphibious columns.

faction.han.name: Han Empire
faction.han.motto: A common future requires a common plan.
faction.han.lore: A post-Blackout restoration movement recast the surviving Chinese central government as the Han Empire, claiming an old dynastic name for a new administrative order. In this setting the title is political, not a claim that its citizens share one ethnicity. Vietnamese and Cambodian successor governments joined through unequal security and infrastructure treaties, retaining their own armed commands. The imperial court promises to end scarcity by coordinating Meridian centrally; its provincial partners disagree sharply over who gets to write the plan.
faction.han.identity: Affordable infantry, unmanned support and vulnerable command links.
faction.han.visual_direction: Jade green, crimson and porcelain; compact modular hulls, sensor crowns and standardized drone racks.
traits_text: Combat infantry cost -15% and build time -15%.
Land combat vehicle health -10%.

A Link Operator or Dragon Command Walker grants friendly unmanned combat units within 5 cells weapon damage +10%. Fields do not stack; destroying or suppressing the provider removes its field. Strengths: combined infantry/drone pressure; weaknesses: fragile vehicles and exposed control units.
faction.han.opening: Use cheap infantry to secure ground, add Ox tanks and Firefly AA, then support a Nest group with protected Link Operators.
faction.han.counterplay: Use area damage against infantry, prioritize command providers, force vehicle trades and do not allow several drone systems to fire behind an intact screen.

faction.ae.name: African Empire
faction.ae.motto: What survives belongs to the future.
faction.ae.lore: Nigerian commercial and civic alliances, a Kongo basin compact and southern industrial states built a reconstruction federation around power corridors and mutual investment. Its elected High Steward adopted the title Emperor after mediating a succession of near-civil wars, turning a temporary compromise into a disputed constitutional institution. This Empire claims no automatic authority over all Africa. It wants to own the machinery of recovery rather than purchase access from outsiders, but debates over corridor revenues and the Steward's emergency powers threaten its cohesion.
faction.ae.identity: Recovery, battlefield salvage and practical industrial endurance.
faction.ae.visual_direction: Ochre, charcoal and bright cyan; repairable panels, reinforced wheels and interchangeable weapon modules.
traits_text: Service Engineers and Reclaimers may salvage destroyed enemy land combat vehicles: an 8-second uninterrupted action yields 20% of the unit's paid purchase cost. Each wreck pays once; allied, self-destroyed, decoy and temporary summoned units produce no income.
Land-vehicle repairs cost 25% fewer credits per health restored.
Land artillery weapon range -10%. Strengths: sustained ground campaigns and economic recovery after winning battles. Weaknesses: must hold the battlefield to salvage, and can be outranged.
faction.ae.opening: Use Buffalo tanks and infantry to win a local fight, secure the area, then bring salvage teams. Spend recovered credits on expansion before attempting an expensive siege push.
faction.ae.counterplay: Disengage before losing vehicles, deny wreck fields with artillery and use air attacks to bypass the repaired frontline.

faction.sap.name: South Asian Protectorate
faction.sap.lore: After successive grid failures and displacement crises, Indian, Pakistani and Thai successor authorities negotiated a mutual-protection compact for power, food and evacuation routes. Thailand belongs through maritime and infrastructure treaties, not through a claim that it is geographically South Asian. The Protectorate was meant to expire when civilian systems recovered. Its military council now argues that only permanent joint guardianship can prevent another catastrophe, while reformers demand the return of emergency powers to local governments.
faction.sap.identity: Protected advances, resilient defenses and battlefield engineering.
faction.sap.visual_direction: Sand, indigo and saffron; layered armor, deployable braces and prominent interception sensors.
traits_text: Defensive structures gain health +15%.

Power reserve: defenses keep operating for 20 seconds after a power shortage begins. Reserve recharges only after 60 continuous seconds of adequate power. EMP-disabled defenses remain disabled; superweapons never use this reserve.
Land combat vehicles move 10% slower. Strengths: protected positions and measured advances. Weaknesses: slow map response and the temptation to overspend on fortifications.
faction.sap.opening: Establish an economical infantry and Bulwark screen, protect the first expansion with a small defense cluster, then move the army forward with artillery rather than staying in the starting base.
faction.sap.counterplay: Expand around the slow army, bait the interception zone away from the real target, use attacks from inside its boundary and punish excessive static defense spending.

roster.napc.vanilla.name: North American Peace Corps / Vanilla
roster.napc.vanilla.title: Vanilla

roster.napc.usa.name: USA
roster.napc.usa.title: Air Mobility Command
roster.napc.usa.lore: The continental airlift service rebuilt scattered cities long before roads reopened. Its commanders believe control of the sky is the only humane way to shorten a war; critics see a doctrine that can leave occupied territory without enough troops to hold it.
roster.napc.usa.identity: Sustained air operations and precision strikes.
roster.napc.usa.superweapon_note: Atlas is unchanged. Use air reconnaissance to find high-value, tightly packed targets.
roster.napc.usa.opening: Build a normal infantry and Guardian screen, then an early Airfield. Mix Raptor loadouts and attack exposed production with Condors.
roster.napc.usa.counterplay: Layer AA with detectors, pressure Airfields, and advance during bomber rearm windows.

roster.napc.canada.name: Canada
roster.napc.canada.title: Northern Littoral Command
roster.napc.canada.lore: Northern ports and lake routes became the continent's winter lifelines. Littoral Command developed sealed vehicles and floating depots for routes that alternated between water, mud and broken pavement. It favors patient advances that keep evacuation routes open.
roster.napc.canada.identity: Amphibious armor and protected transport; useful on rivers and ordinary land.
modifiers_text: Amphibious combat units gain health +10% on all terrain.
Amphibious vehicle movement speed on water +20%.
roster.napc.canada.superweapon_note: Atlas is unchanged. Amphibious scouts enable attacks behind a coastal defense line.
roster.napc.canada.opening: Use infantry and Beavers until Radar unlocks Narwhals; attack across secondary routes while frigates protect the crossing.
roster.napc.canada.counterplay: Pressure before Radar, cover exits from water, and use air attacks against the slower siege component.

roster.napc.mexico.name: Mexico
roster.napc.mexico.title: Federal Vanguard
roster.napc.mexico.lore: Mexican reconstruction brigades cleared rail junctions and defended dense resettlement districts. Their veterans formed the Federal Vanguard, demanding that the Corps protect inhabited places rather than merely draw secure borders around them. Their political leverage rests on citizen soldiers who expect to go home.
roster.napc.mexico.identity: Affordable assault infantry with strong urban pressure.
roster.napc.mexico.superweapon_note: Atlas is unchanged. Use it to break fortified positions that infantry cannot safely approach.
roster.napc.mexico.opening: Contest capture points with Vanguard squads; use Guardians and Javelins to protect Aguila teams approaching buildings.
roster.napc.mexico.counterplay: Use conventional area damage, mobile machine-gun vehicles and repeated flanking moves; deny safe rally points.
