roster.nec.nordics.name: Nordics
roster.nec.nordics.title: Northern Watch
roster.nec.nordics.lore: Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland pooled maritime surveillance and dispersed defense commands after repeated failures of centralized dispatch. Northern Watch treats early warning as a public service and prefers to lose ground briefly rather than lose the soldiers needed to retake it.
roster.nec.nordics.identity: Reconnaissance, mobile missiles and coastal denial.
modifiers_text: Amphibious vehicle movement speed +15% on land and water.
roster.nec.nordics.superweapon_note: Aurora is unchanged. Exploit the shutdown to reposition missile carriers rather than attempting a heavy frontal breakthrough.
roster.nec.nordics.opening: Use Fen carriers to reveal attack routes and screen mobile artillery with infantry and Rapiers.
roster.nec.nordics.counterplay: Close distance under smoke or cover, bring detectors, and force fights where thin armor cannot disengage.

roster.nec.eurocorps.name: Eurocorps
roster.nec.eurocorps.title: Franco-German Armored Directorate
roster.nec.eurocorps.lore: France and Germany sponsor the largest shared manufacturing program in the Confederation. Eurocorps sees common equipment and professional command as the antidote to political fragmentation. Its critics see procurement policy turning into a claim to lead every coalition operation.
roster.nec.eurocorps.identity: Expensive armored formations and siege breakthroughs.
modifiers_text: All land combat vehicle build time +10%.
roster.nec.eurocorps.superweapon_note: Aurora is unchanged. Time the shutdown with the slow advance and deployment of the siege line.
roster.nec.eurocorps.opening: Defend with infantry and Surveyors until Radar unlocks Marte; add Relays before building a costly siege group.
roster.nec.eurocorps.counterplay: Punish the delayed tank timing, flank deployed guns and force this expensive army to defend several places.

roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.name: Alpine Brotherhood
roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.title: Pass and Tunnel Compact
roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.lore: Austria, Switzerland and Italy formed mutual rescue and engineering associations to keep mountain passes, reservoirs and tunnel networks usable. The Brotherhood grew from these civic oaths into a military compact. Its loyalties run first to protected communities, sometimes at the expense of confederal strategy.
roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.identity: Fortified infantry, compact artillery positions and repairable defenses.
roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.superweapon_note: Aurora is unchanged. Use the interruption to advance pioneers and establish the next defensive position.
roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.opening: Hold a narrow front with Pioneers, Ibex guns and Rapiers; expand behind the line rather than investing everything in one fortress.
roster.nec.alpine_brotherhood.counterplay: Out-expand the compact army, use long-range siege and avoid feeding infantry into prepared cover.

roster.olm.vanilla.name: Order of the Levant and Mediterranean / Vanilla
roster.olm.vanilla.title: Vanilla
roster.olm.vanilla.lore: Desalination operators, Levantine municipal councils and Mediterranean convoy leagues created an oath-bound order to defend water and energy infrastructure during the Blackout. Membership is civic and includes many faiths and secular communities. The Order now protects a chain of coastal enclaves rather than a continuous empire. It argues that no distant government should be able to shut off another city's water. Its solar directorates nevertheless want exclusive custody of the very Meridian controls that would make such coercion possible.
roster.olm.vanilla.identity: Mobile combined arms, concealment and abundant electrical power.
roster.olm.vanilla.opening: Use Caravan and Sirocco groups to threaten several routes, screen retreats with Dust Screen, and bring Observers before attempting a siege.
roster.olm.vanilla.counterplay: Keep a mobile reserve, force close fights, detect concealed observers and attack the thin frontline before energy weapons can concentrate.

roster.olm.saudi_arabia.name: Saudi Arabia
roster.olm.saudi_arabia.title: Solar Directorate
roster.olm.saudi_arabia.lore: The Directorate operates vast solar farms, storage fields and desalination plants rebuilt after the Blackout. Its technocrats insist that dependable power requires unified command. Water councils accuse them of turning an emergency engineering mandate into a permanent monopoly.
roster.olm.saudi_arabia.identity: Energy weapons and power-efficient late-game positions.
modifiers_text: Generator output +20% relative to the parent faction.
roster.olm.saudi_arabia.superweapon_note: Helios receives the thermal-beam damage modifier, but not unit-only cooling upgrades. Its warning and area are unchanged.
roster.olm.saudi_arabia.opening: Build a conventional screen, then Dawn AA and Ifrits. Keep enough mobile Siroccos to prevent opponents bypassing the beam line.
roster.olm.saudi_arabia.counterplay: Attack from multiple angles, use smoke against direct-fire units, and exploit the cooling period after Capacitor Discharge.

modifier_applications.unresolved_target_domain: Thermal-beam weapons and defenses; exact weapon registry is not yet specified.

roster.olm.algeria.name: Algeria
roster.olm.algeria.title: Saharan Corridor Guard
roster.olm.algeria.lore: The Corridor Guard began as a federation of railway crews, oasis councils and convoy escorts linking coast and interior. Its commanders distrust static borders and defend movement itself as the basis of political independence. They support the Order while resisting solar-directorate control of transit routes.
roster.olm.algeria.identity: Fast light vehicles, ambushes and harassment.
roster.olm.algeria.superweapon_note: Helios is unchanged. It supplies the heavy base-breaking pressure missing from the light-vehicle roster.
roster.olm.algeria.opening: Raid collectors with Rovers and Needle passengers. Use Scorpions for repeated short attacks rather than prolonged firing lines.
roster.olm.algeria.counterplay: Escort harvesters with detectors, hold mobile AA nearby and use fast splash-damage units to deny escape routes.

roster.olm.el_andalus.name: El-Andalus
roster.olm.el_andalus.title: Western Straits Compact
roster.olm.el_andalus.lore: El-Andalus is a future Spanish coastal compact whose name deliberately invokes a layered regional past, rather than a religious conquest or a claim over present-day Spain. Port municipalities joined the Order after eastern power links failed. Its assemblies demand open shipping and local autonomy, often challenging the Order's more centralized directorates.
roster.olm.el_andalus.identity: Port defense, durable escorts and infantry holding power.
roster.olm.el_andalus.superweapon_note: Helios is unchanged. Use its fixed line to force enemies away from a defended crossing or coastal approach.
roster.olm.el_andalus.opening: Secure buildings with Gate Guards, then combine Siroccos and Sandglass mortars. On water maps, add escort groups before expensive siege ships.
roster.olm.el_andalus.counterplay: Attack outside garrison coverage, use indirect fire and overwhelm the compact army before it can protect several approaches.

conditions: The infantry unit occupies a marked civilian garrison.

roster.def.vanilla.name: Democratic Eurasian Federation / Vanilla
roster.def.vanilla.title: Vanilla
roster.def.vanilla.lore: The Federation emerged from emergency congresses linking surviving Russian regions, Kazakh transport authorities and the northern Korean industrial state. Its charter distributes representation among territorial and workplace assemblies, but wartime production quotas give the central supply ministry enormous power. Some districts defend the federation as their only protection from abandonment; others call its elections ceremonial. It wants Meridian reopened as a shared industrial backbone and is willing to occupy reluctant junction cities to make the plan function.
roster.def.vanilla.identity: Industrial volume, artillery saturation and replaceable armored forces.
roster.def.vanilla.opening: Use cheap Hammers and infantry to contest two fronts, establish the economy behind them, then build a screened Anvil line rather than rushing one expensive capstone.
roster.def.vanilla.counterplay: Attack collectors, force artillery to redeploy, strike several fronts and avoid engaging the entire production stream head-on.

roster.def.russia.name: Russia
roster.def.russia.title: Northern Arsenal Command
roster.def.russia.lore: The northern arsenal regions rebuilt around armored factories and winterized transport hubs. Their delegates promise that industrial self-sufficiency will prevent another collapse. The army's demand for predictable supply repeatedly clashes with local assemblies over how much civilian recovery can be postponed.
roster.def.russia.identity: Slow armored assaults with active protection.
roster.def.russia.superweapon_note: Perun is unchanged. Use it to remove a strongpoint before committing slow armor.
roster.def.russia.opening: Screen with infantry and Mules until Radar; build a compact Ural spearhead supported by Porcupines and artillery.
roster.def.russia.counterplay: Raid around the spearhead, use guns or beams that bypass missile interception, and strike weak rear armor.

roster.def.kazakhstan.name: Kazakhstan
roster.def.kazakhstan.title: Steppe Transit Command
roster.def.kazakhstan.lore: Railway cities and open-country logistics authorities formed Transit Command to keep east-west movement from becoming a hostage of any one capital. Its troops favor dispersed depots and short engagements. Within the Federation, it is the loudest voice against concentrating every reserve in a few enormous arsenals.
roster.def.kazakhstan.identity: Fast reconnaissance and mobile missile warfare.
modifiers_text: Refinery build cost -15%; collectors are not discounted.
roster.def.kazakhstan.superweapon_note: Perun is unchanged. Recon carriers provide targeting for the heavy strike absent from the regular mobile roster.
roster.def.kazakhstan.opening: Scout aggressively, establish a second collection route and use Sakers to strike valuable units before withdrawing.
roster.def.kazakhstan.counterplay: Use fast attackers and aircraft, deny retreat routes and punish the thin armor whenever it stops to fire.

roster.def.north_korea.name: North Korea
roster.def.north_korea.title: Fortress Reconstruction Bureau
roster.def.north_korea.lore: Following the Blackout, competing military and industrial councils reorganized the northern Korean state around hardened local districts. The Bureau joined the Federation for fuel and machine tools while retaining strict internal controls. Its engineers excel at redundancy and deception; its civilians bear the cost of reconstruction plans written as permanent mobilization.
roster.def.north_korea.identity: Durable infantry, prepared positions and decoys.
roster.def.north_korea.superweapon_note: Perun is unchanged. Decoys conceal preparations; they never hide or falsify the real superweapon countdown.
roster.def.north_korea.opening: Build overlapping infantry positions and a modest Hammer reserve, using decoys to make the location of the real artillery line uncertain.
roster.def.north_korea.counterplay: Verify targets with detectors, attack the economy outside fortified districts and use sustained siege rather than chasing decoys.

roster.pd.vanilla.name: Pacific Dominion / Vanilla
roster.pd.vanilla.title: Vanilla
roster.pd.vanilla.lore: Australia, Indonesian maritime leagues and Japanese industrial authorities kept each other alive through a chain of protected shipping routes. Their emergency maritime command became the Pacific Dominion: a treaty government whose authority is strongest at sea and contested on land. Its admirals want Meridian reopened without allowing a continental power to dictate access to ports. Smaller islands increasingly ask whether the Dominion's promise of open passage includes the right to refuse its bases.
roster.pd.vanilla.identity: Amphibious maneuver, naval reach and flexible coastal logistics.
roster.pd.vanilla.opening: Use Wake Skimmers and Tide Tanks to threaten routes that conventional armies cannot cover cheaply; build enough Storm AA to protect the landing area before investing in a fleet.
roster.pd.vanilla.counterplay: Guard landing exits, attack weak static defenses and keep aircraft ready to strike isolated amphibious columns.

unit.shared.collector.source_text: Collectors are amphibious and can cross navigable water at 70% of their land speed. They still collect only from designated deposits and unload at a Refinery.

roster.pd.australia.name: Australia
roster.pd.australia.title: Southern Reach Command
roster.pd.australia.lore: Remote settlements and long supply lines taught Southern Reach to value information and range over dense occupation. It supports the Dominion as a safeguard for trade, but resists proposals to turn every maritime dispute into a permanent continental deployment.
roster.pd.australia.identity: Long-range expeditionary artillery backed by reconnaissance aircraft.
roster.pd.australia.superweapon_note: Tempest Swarm is unchanged. Use it to force a defended enemy position to split attention between the air and artillery.
roster.pd.australia.opening: Build a compact marine and Tide screen, then Wedge reconnaissance and Outrider batteries. Relocate as soon as the firing line is exposed.
roster.pd.australia.counterplay: Rush the artillery, contest reconnaissance aircraft and use raids to stretch a small expeditionary screen.

unit.shared.collector.source_text: Collectors are amphibious and can cross navigable water at 70% of their land speed. They still collect only from designated deposits and unload at a Refinery.

roster.pd.indonesia.name: Indonesia
roster.pd.indonesia.title: Archipelago Defense League
roster.pd.indonesia.lore: Island governments joined their patrol fleets and rescue services to keep local routes open when distant command centers failed. The League supplies much of the Dominion's landing infantry and insists that maritime security must answer to the communities living beside the ports.
roster.pd.indonesia.identity: Transport assaults, inexpensive marines and raids across several routes.
roster.pd.indonesia.superweapon_note: The Tempest Swarm Hub remains available despite losing the Tempest Carrier; they are separate technologies.
roster.pd.indonesia.opening: Move Raiders in several Kancils, force defenders to commit to one approach, then land elsewhere. Use normal artillery for sustained land siege.
roster.pd.indonesia.counterplay: Scout the real transports, use area damage at unloading points and force Raiders to fight after their arrival bonus expires.

unit.shared.collector.source_text: Collectors are amphibious and can cross navigable water at 70% of their land speed. They still collect only from designated deposits and unload at a Refinery.

roster.pd.japan.name: Japan
roster.pd.japan.title: Maritime Systems Authority
roster.pd.japan.lore: Industrial cities and shipyard administrations rebuilt Japan's defense around automation because skilled crews were scarce after the Blackout. The Authority treats precise, limited operations as a way to preserve lives. Its reliance on remote systems has widened the political distance between those authorizing force and those living under it.
roster.pd.japan.identity: Expensive precision systems, adaptable armor and advanced carriers.
modifiers_text: Aircraft and ship reload intervals -10%; Airfield rearm time is unchanged.
roster.pd.japan.superweapon_note: Tempest Swarm is unchanged; combat-unit cost and reload modifiers do not apply to temporary superweapon drones.
roster.pd.japan.opening: Use infantry and Skimmers until Radar unlocks Shinanos. On land, their siege mode replaces the lost howitzer; at sea, build one well-escorted Shogun.
roster.pd.japan.counterplay: Exploit the delayed tank timing, force expensive units to split and attack while carriers change wing types.

unit.shared.collector.source_text: Collectors are amphibious and can cross navigable water at 70% of their land speed. They still collect only from designated deposits and unload at a Refinery.

roster.han.vanilla.name: Han Empire / Vanilla
roster.han.vanilla.title: Vanilla
roster.han.vanilla.lore: A post-Blackout restoration movement recast the surviving Chinese central government as the Han Empire, claiming an old dynastic name for a new administrative order. In this setting the title is political, not a claim that its citizens share one ethnicity. Vietnamese and Cambodian successor governments joined through unequal security and infrastructure treaties, retaining their own armed commands. The imperial court promises to end scarcity by coordinating Meridian centrally; its provincial partners disagree sharply over who gets to write the plan.
roster.han.vanilla.identity: Affordable infantry, unmanned support and vulnerable command links.
roster.han.vanilla.opening: Use cheap infantry to secure ground, add Ox tanks and Firefly AA, then support a Nest group with protected Link Operators.
roster.han.vanilla.counterplay: Use area damage against infantry, prioritize command providers, force vehicle trades and do not allow several drone systems to fire behind an intact screen.

roster.han.china.name: China
roster.han.china.title: Imperial Standards Army
roster.han.china.lore: The central Standards Army presents uniform equipment and reliable public works as proof of the restoration's legitimacy. Its armored commands protect the routes that bind imperial provinces together. Their officers are divided between rebuilding a useful state and enforcing the court's demand for obedience.
roster.han.china.identity: Heavy armor and stronger local command coverage.
roster.han.china.superweapon_note: Dragonfall is unchanged. Temporary siege engines cannot benefit from Central Priority or Guard Integration.
roster.han.china.opening: Use Banner and Lance infantry to survive until Radar, then combine Guard tanks with Fireflies, Nest drones and a command provider.
roster.han.china.counterplay: Attack before the first Guard tanks arrive, remove providers and use terrain to prevent the army concentrating its expensive core.

roster.han.vietnam.name: Vietnam
roster.han.vietnam.title: Canopy Defense Command
roster.han.vietnam.lore: Vietnamese defense councils entered the imperial treaty system to secure reconstruction supplies while preserving operational autonomy. Canopy Command regards dispersed defense as insurance against both foreign invasion and imperial overreach. Its soldiers train for ambushes in any terrain, not only forests.
roster.han.vietnam.identity: Concealed infantry and amphibious rocket raids.
roster.han.vietnam.superweapon_note: Dragonfall remains available despite losing the Dragon Command Walker; it is an independent strategic structure.
roster.han.vietnam.opening: Threaten several approaches with Rangers; bring Link Operators and Reed skimmers to turn an ambush into a short, concentrated barrage.
roster.han.vietnam.counterplay: Use detectors and persistent scouting, keep units spread against rockets and pressure the faction when it cannot safely reset concealment.

roster.han.cambodia.name: Cambodia
roster.han.cambodia.title: Mekong Reconstruction Authority
roster.han.cambodia.lore: The Authority grew from river engineers, agricultural cooperatives and urban repair teams. It accepted imperial backing to rebuild transport and irrigation, then developed its own field robotics to reduce dependence on imported crews. Its leadership balances material gains against the fear that every new connection also tightens political control.
roster.han.cambodia.identity: Drone sustain, field repair and economical support systems.
modifiers_text: Repairs to friendly structures progress 25% faster; cost per health is unchanged.
roster.han.cambodia.superweapon_note: Dragonfall is unchanged. Its temporary engines cannot be repaired by Lotus Tenders, Engineers or Repair Swarm.
roster.han.cambodia.opening: Use infantry to shield Fireflies and Nest drones, keeping a few Lotus Tenders behind the line. Avoid trading support vehicles for a short-lived damage advantage.
roster.han.cambodia.counterplay: Focus one target at a time, kill Tenders and deployed engineers, and prevent the army withdrawing to repair.

modifier_applications.unresolved_target_domain: Carrier-launched drones are also unmanned, but their pricing/replacement costs are unspecified.

roster.ae.vanilla.name: African Empire / Vanilla
roster.ae.vanilla.title: Vanilla
roster.ae.vanilla.lore: Nigerian commercial and civic alliances, a Kongo basin compact and southern industrial states built a reconstruction federation around power corridors and mutual investment. Its elected High Steward adopted the title Emperor after mediating a succession of near-civil wars, turning a temporary compromise into a disputed constitutional institution. This Empire claims no automatic authority over all Africa. It wants to own the machinery of recovery rather than purchase access from outsiders, but debates over corridor revenues and the Steward's emergency powers threaten its cohesion.
roster.ae.vanilla.identity: Recovery, battlefield salvage and practical industrial endurance.
roster.ae.vanilla.opening: Use Buffalo tanks and infantry to win a local fight, secure the area, then bring salvage teams. Spend recovered credits on expansion before attempting an expensive siege push.
roster.ae.vanilla.counterplay: Disengage before losing vehicles, deny wreck fields with artillery and use air attacks to bypass the repaired frontline.

conditions: The target is receiving paid land-vehicle repairs.

roster.ae.nigeria.name: Nigeria
roster.ae.nigeria.title: Civic Logistics Directorate
roster.ae.nigeria.lore: Metropolitan councils, inland trade unions and communications firms formed the Directorate to prevent recovery funds disappearing into regional patronage. Its army combines rapidly organized infantry with field communications and drone support. Political rivals accuse it of mistaking the interests of its largest cities for those of the whole Empire.
roster.ae.nigeria.identity: Fast mobilization, infantry presence and protective drone support.
roster.ae.nigeria.superweapon_note: Horizon is unchanged; the structure construction bonus does not shorten its build time or recharge.
roster.ae.nigeria.opening: Secure several points with Civic teams, support them with Lagos vehicles and Buffalo tanks, and use superior presence to protect collectors and wreck fields.
roster.ae.nigeria.counterplay: Use mobile area damage, destroy exposed support drones and force infantry to leave the infrastructure that strengthens them.

conditions: The target is receiving paid land-vehicle repairs.

roster.ae.kongo.name: Kongo
roster.ae.kongo.title: River Compact Guard
roster.ae.kongo.lore: Kongo here names a fictional multi-state Congo Basin compact, not a claim that today's countries have merged. River councils and conservation authorities built its institutions around navigable routes, reservoirs and protected catchments. The Guard supports imperial industry but resists extraction that destroys the infrastructure and communities it is meant to serve.
roster.ae.kongo.identity: Amphibious transport, durable infantry and concealed recovery teams.
modifiers_text: Amphibious vehicle movement speed +20% on land and water.
roster.ae.kongo.superweapon_note: Horizon is unchanged. Its slowing debris can protect a retreat, but also slows friendly vehicles.
roster.ae.kongo.opening: Move Wardens and infantry in Okapis, attack vulnerable resource routes, and retreat damaged vehicles behind the infantry screen for repair.
roster.ae.kongo.counterplay: Watch alternative crossings, reveal Wardens with detectors and use long-range artillery to deny safe recovery positions.

conditions: The target is receiving paid land-vehicle repairs.

roster.ae.south_africa.name: South Africa
roster.ae.south_africa.title: Southern Arsenal Union
roster.ae.south_africa.lore: The Union links manufacturing cities, research institutions and organized labor under a common reconstruction charter. It supplies much of the Empire's precision machinery and insists that technical independence must include domestic control of design and production. Its influence grows with every weapon sold to its partners.
roster.ae.south_africa.identity: Long-range ground weapons and expensive precision vehicles.
roster.ae.south_africa.superweapon_note: Horizon is unchanged. Unit-range upgrades never increase the strategic weapon's map reach.
roster.ae.south_africa.opening: Use infantry and Mambas until Radar, then establish overlapping Rhino and Protea firing lines. Keep enough AA to protect a ground-focused force.
roster.ae.south_africa.counterplay: Pressure before Radar, use infantry swarms and flanking attacks, and force expensive guns to keep changing firing modes.

conditions: The target is receiving paid land-vehicle repairs.

roster.sap.vanilla.name: South Asian Protectorate / Vanilla
roster.sap.vanilla.title: Vanilla
roster.sap.vanilla.lore: After successive grid failures and displacement crises, Indian, Pakistani and Thai successor authorities negotiated a mutual-protection compact for power, food and evacuation routes. Thailand belongs through maritime and infrastructure treaties, not through a claim that it is geographically South Asian. The Protectorate was meant to expire when civilian systems recovered. Its military council now argues that only permanent joint guardianship can prevent another catastrophe, while reformers demand the return of emergency powers to local governments.
roster.sap.vanilla.identity: Protected advances, resilient defenses and battlefield engineering.
roster.sap.vanilla.opening: Establish an economical infantry and Bulwark screen, protect the first expansion with a small defense cluster, then move the army forward with artillery rather than staying in the starting base.
roster.sap.vanilla.counterplay: Expand around the slow army, bait the interception zone away from the real target, use attacks from inside its boundary and punish excessive static defense spending.

roster.sap.india.name: India
roster.sap.india.title: Integrated Defense Command
roster.sap.india.lore: The largest Protectorate member rebuilt joint logistics across a patchwork of surviving state institutions. Integrated Defense Command wants military compatibility to make mutual protection credible. Its size also makes neighboring partners wary that integration could become another word for dependence.
roster.sap.india.identity: Heavy protected pushes supported by economical power infrastructure.
roster.sap.india.superweapon_note: Trident is unchanged. Use it over the destination of an armored advance rather than always over the starting base.
roster.sap.india.opening: Defend with infantry until Radar, then push with Arjuns, Vajras and Gaj platforms in stages, keeping a modest power surplus.
roster.sap.india.counterplay: Exploit slow production, use non-missile anti-tank weapons and force repeated Gaj redeployment.

roster.sap.thailand.name: Thailand
roster.sap.thailand.title: River and Strait Command
roster.sap.thailand.lore: Thai river authorities and maritime services joined the Protectorate to secure both inland food routes and access to the wider ocean. Their commanders favor flexible defense and evacuation over static prestige projects. They often mediate between the compact's continental powers while resisting demands to commit everything to their border disputes.
roster.sap.thailand.identity: Amphibious infantry assaults and mobile defense.
roster.sap.thailand.superweapon_note: Trident is unchanged. The zone can cover either end of a crossing, but not both if they lie outside its radius.
roster.sap.thailand.opening: Use Nagas to relocate infantry rapidly, keep Monsoon guns behind the landing area, and defend several approaches with a mobile reserve.
roster.sap.thailand.counterplay: Attack after disembarkation protection expires, control crossing exits and use heavy armor against the lighter assault groups.

roster.sap.pakistan.name: Pakistan
roster.sap.pakistan.title: Frontier Observation Command
roster.sap.pakistan.lore: Frontier Observation Command arose from early-warning services and reconstruction troops protecting long, exposed corridors. It supports mutual protection but demands safeguards against domination by larger partners. Its doctrine emphasizes finding an attack early and disrupting it before a costly close battle begins.
roster.sap.pakistan.identity: Long-range missile artillery and concealed forward observation.
modifiers_text: Ordinary guided-missile flight speed +20%; excludes superweapons.
roster.sap.pakistan.superweapon_note: Trident is unchanged. Protect a missile battery during a decisive salvo, then relocate before the zone expires.
roster.sap.pakistan.opening: Scout with Jackals and Watchpost teams; protect Shaheens with Bulwarks and Vajras. Fire from unexpected angles rather than making one enormous gun line.
roster.sap.pakistan.counterplay: Hunt observers with detectors, use aircraft and fast vehicles, and move immediately after firing to evade Counterlaunch Plot.

modifier_applications.unresolved_target_domain: Ordinary guided-missile projectile templates; exact weapon registry is not yet specified.

prototype_priorities: Prototype the eight vanilla rosters before adding all 24 variants. Give each faction a playable early anti-infantry unit, anti-tank answer, detector, mobile AA and siege route before tuning special mechanics.
Use three map families: open land, constrained urban routes, and mixed coast/river. Include at least two exits from each starting area; avoid mandatory water for baseline economic access.

Measure first scout, first tank, first mobile AA, first siege and first superweapon timings. A variant that moves its tank from T1 to T2 must survive with its actual T1 roster, not an assumed inherited tank.
Test equal-spend armies, then repeat with reinforcements, repairs and travel time. A nominally equal fight can still favor a faction that reaches the next battle earlier.
Track salvage credits as a share of total income. If African wins create an excessive snowball, reduce salvage payout before weakening every unit.
Measure damage escaped during superweapon warnings, Tempest losses to AA, Dragonfall assembly survival and Trident charges spent. All strategic weapons should create decisions for the defender.
Keep duplicate command fields, repair stations and decoy income disabled. Never let a replacement inherit both its old unit's special ability and its new ability unless explicitly stated.

Only after these tests, assign final unit costs, health, damage, armor classes, reloads and speed. The present document is a complete faction/technology proposal, not a verified competitive balance patch.
